description.en: Community-published plugins for DeepSeek Harness. Add this index URL as a market source to browse and install.
description.zh: 社区发布的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。将此索引 URL 添加为市场源即可浏览与安装。

title.zh: 经本地 API 离线可用

description.en: Zotero tools for DeepSeek Harness via the Zotero local API (no API key): search your library, read item metadata and abstracts, list collections and attachments, read PDF full text (on-the-fly parsing), download PDFs and manage notes.
description.zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API key）为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Zotero 工具：检索文献库、读取条目元数据与摘要、浏览分类与附件、解析并阅读 PDF 全文、下载 PDF 以及管理笔记。
